name: Nexus Crown Array
introDiscord:
Six enormous rings orbit a central crown-shaped structure.

Each ring contains glimpses of a different region.

Shizuki immediately wrote:

'ANOTHER CROWN.

I AM QUALIFIED AFTER SUNKEN KINGDOM.'
introTwitch:
Six enormous rings orbit a central crown-shaped structure.

Each ring contains glimpses of a different region.

Shizuki immediately wrote:

'ANOTHER CROWN.

I AM QUALIFIED AFTER SUNKEN KINGDOM.'

nexus-crown-array-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Nexus Crown Array.

left.message: A ring aligned with Moonlit Reef releases restorative light.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Nexus Crown Construct descends from the Array.

forward.message: A cache rotates through all six rings.

nexus-crown-array-depths.prompt: Deeper within Nexus Crown Array, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message:
One Berry sits beneath a paper crown.

Shizuki wrote:

'Queen of Nexus.

Authority:

same as last time.'

forward.message: A Construct activates beneath the six regions.

nexus-crown-array-threshold.prompt: Near Crown of Six Currents, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A Nexus Crown Construct blocks the central ring.

right.message: Six gentle currents overlap and restore you.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A coffer bears symbols from every mapped region.

boss-antechamber.name: Crown of Six Currents
boss-antechamber.prompt: Crown of Six Currents locks into place.

bossPromptDiscord:
Crown of Six Currents locks into place.

A regal construct forms beneath it.

Use /yes to approach or /no to avoid Shizuki starting
another constitutional crisis.
bossPromptTwitch:

bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Crown of Six Currents. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The six rings bow inward.

Convergence Monarch reveals itself!

completionText:
The Crown opens.

Beyond it is not another region.

It is a memory.
